newsitem.title: USA: Covol finalizes coal facility sale.
newsitem.headline: Covol finalizes coal facility sale.

text.p: Covol Technologies Inc said it finalized the sale of a synthetic coal briquetting facility in Utah to Coaltech No. 1 LP, a limited partnership in which it is a general partner.
The Utah Synfuel No. 1 facility converts small particles of coal, called coal fines, into a solid synthetic fuel using Covol's patented technology, the company said.

The purchaser is a limited partnership consisting of Covol, AJG Financial Services Inc and Square D Co, it said. AJG Financial is a wholly-owned unit of Arthur J. Gallagher & Co and Square D is an affiliate of Schneider SA, the company said.

The transaction included the sale of the facility for $3.5 million and the granting of a license to use Covol's patented coal briquetting technology, the company said. Covol would also operate the plant for a designated fee per ton, it said.
